description:
Get token holdings with current USD value for a Stacks wallet address. Shows portfolio composition including token balances and estimated values. Powered by the Tenero API (api.tenero.io). No authentication required.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

chain.description: Chain to query: stacks, spark, or sportsfun (default: stacks)

name: tenero_wallet_holdings
